title: SPACESNFT
tagline: NFT community based dApp - NFT is not just about collections is about building communities.
description:
SpacesNFT is the best NFT community dApp where community builders can create their own web3 community and allow to them to create advanced NFT collections to a lot of use cases: Collectibles, POAPs, Music, Video game Items... All in the same Space.

Community also has a place to community to other space members as the chat and video or group calls.
how_its_made:
This project uses as blockchain base FVM Filecoin and for storage nft.storage. 
FVM is faster and cheaper to interact that other EVM compatible chains. nft.storage allows us to store the metadata and retrieve when we needed.

Other dev stack is: 
Contracts: Solidity
Frontend: React/TS
Backend: NodeJS/TS and AWS lambda functions
Database: MongoDB
